column2: 你要寫信給以弗所教會的使者，說：那右手拿著七星、在七個金燈臺中間行走的，說：
column3: 'To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: The One who holds the seven stars in His right hand, the One who walks among the seven golden lampstands, says this:

column2: 我知道你的行為、勞碌、忍耐，也知道你不能容忍惡人。你也曾試驗那自稱為使徒卻不是使徒的，看出他們是假的來。
column3: 'I know your deeds and your toil and perseverance, and that you cannot tolerate evil men, and you put to the test those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and you found them [to be] false;

column2: 你也能忍耐，曾為我的名勞苦，並不乏倦。
column3: and you have perseverance and have endured for My name's sake, and have not grown weary.

column2: 然而有一件事我要責備你，就是你把起初的愛心離棄了。
column3: 'But I have [this] against you, that you have left your first love.

column2: 所以，應當回想你是從那裡墜落的，並要悔改，行起初所行的事。你若不悔改，我就臨到你那裡，把你的燈臺從原處挪去。
column3: 'Therefore remember from where you have fallen, and repent and do the deeds you did at first; or else I am coming to you and will remove your lampstand out of its place-- unless you repent.

column2: 然而你還有一件可取的事，就是你恨惡尼哥拉一黨人的行為，這也是我所恨惡的。
column3: 'Yet this you do have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

column2: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，我必將神樂園中生命樹的果子賜給他吃。
column3: 'He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes, I will grant to eat of the tree of life which is in the Paradise of God.'

column2: 你要寫信給士每拿教會的使者，說：那首先的、末後的、死過又活的，說：
column3: 'And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life, says this:

column2: 我知道你的患難，你的貧窮（你卻是富足的），也知道那自稱是猶太人所說的毀謗話，其實他們不是猶太人，乃是撒但一會的人。
column3: 'I know your tribulation and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy by those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

column2: 你將要受的苦你不用怕。魔鬼要把你們中間幾個人下在監裡，叫你們被試煉，你們必受患難十日。你務要至死忠心，我就賜給你那生命的冠冕。
column3: 'Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to cast some of you into prison, so that you will be tested, and you will have tribulation for ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.

column2: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，必不受第二次死的害。
column3: 'He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes will not be hurt by the second death.'

column2: 你要寫信給別迦摩教會的使者，說：那有兩刃利劍的，說：
column3: 'And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: The One who has the sharp two-edged sword says this:

column2: 我知道你的居所，就是有撒但座位之處；當我忠心的見證人安提帕在你們中間、撒但所住的地方被殺之時，你還堅守我的名，沒有棄絕我的道。
column3: 'I know where you dwell, where Satan's throne is; and you hold fast My name, and did not deny My faith even in the days of Antipas, My witness, My faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

column2: 然而，有幾件事我要責備你：因為在你那裡有人服從了巴蘭的教訓；這巴蘭曾教導巴勒將絆腳石放在以色列人面前，叫他們吃祭偶像之物，行姦淫的事。
column3: 'But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who kept teaching Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit [acts of] immorality.

column2: 你那裡也有人照樣服從了尼哥拉一黨人的教訓。
column3: 'So you also have some who in the same way hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

column2: 所以，你當悔改；若不悔改，我就快臨到你那裡，用我口中的劍攻擊他們。
column3: 'Therefore repent; or else I am coming to you quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of My mouth.

column2: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，我必將那隱藏的嗎哪賜給他，並賜他一塊白石，石上寫著新名；除了那領受的以外，沒有人能認識。
column3: 'He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes, to him I will give [some] of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and a new name written on the stone which no one knows but he who receives it.'

column2: 你要寫信給推雅推喇教會的使者，說：那眼目如火燄、腳像光明銅的神之子說：
column3: 'And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: The Son of God, who has eyes like a flame of fire, and His feet are like burnished bronze, says this:

column2: 我知道你的行為、愛心、信心、勤勞、忍耐，又知道你末後所行的善事，比起初所行的更多。
column3: 'I know your deeds, and your love and faith and service and perseverance, and that your deeds of late are greater than at first.

column2: 然而，有一件事我要責備你，就是你容讓那自稱是先知的婦人耶洗別教導我的僕人，引誘他們行姦淫，吃祭偶像之物。
column3: 'But I have [this] against you, that you tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, and she teaches and leads My bond-servants astray so that they commit [acts of] immorality and eat things sacrificed to idols.

column2: 我曾給他悔改的機會，他卻不肯悔改他的淫行。
column3: 'I gave her time to repent, and she does not want to repent of her immorality.

column2: 看哪，我要叫他病臥在床。那些與他行淫的人，若不悔改所行的，我也要叫他們同受大患難。
column3: 'Behold, I will throw her on a bed [of sickness], and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of her deeds.

column2: 我又要殺死他的黨類（原文是兒女），叫眾教會知道，我是那察看人肺腑心腸的，並要照你們的行為報應你們各人。
column3: 'And I will kill her children with pestilence, and all the churches will know that I am He who searches the minds and hearts; and I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

column2: 至於你們推雅推喇其餘的人，就是一切不從那教訓、不曉得他們素常所說撒但深奧之理的人，我告訴你們，我不將別的擔子放在你們身上。
column3: 'But I say to you, the rest who are in Thyatira, who do not hold this teaching, who have not known the deep things of Satan, as they call them-- I place no other burden on you.

column2: 但你們已經有的，總要持守，直等到我來。
column3: 'Nevertheless what you have, hold fast until I come.

column2: 那得勝又遵守我命令到底的，我要賜給他權柄制伏列國；
column3: 'He who overcomes, and he who keeps My deeds until the end, TO HIM I WILL GIVE AUTHORITY OVER THE NATIONS;

column2: 他必用鐵杖轄管（轄管：原文是牧）他們，將他們如同窯戶的瓦器打得粉碎，像我從我父領受的權柄一樣。
column3: AND HE SHALL RULE THEM WITH A ROD OF IRON, AS THE VESSELS OF THE POTTER ARE BROKEN TO PIECES, as I also have received [authority] from My Father;

column2: 我又要把晨星賜給他。
column3: and I will give him the morning star.

column2: 聖靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！
column3: 'He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.'
